purpose: Validate a structured e-invoice against EN 16931-1:2026 mandatory field requirements for ViDA Digital Reporting Requirements. Checks invoice_number, invoice_date, currency_code, seller_name, buyer_name, seller_vat_id, syntax_id, vat_breakdown, and total_with_vat. Returns conformance verdict and missing-field list. Root node of the vida-digital-reporting-requirements chain. Zero network, zero PII. EU 2025/516, mandatory 2030-07-01.
